0022600103.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (1-0, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back) visit the Sacramento Kings (0-1, 4th in the Pacific, 1 game back) in the second game of the Trail Blazers' 2026-27 season. Portland will be without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Trail Blazers won the last meeting 122-110 in Portland on April 12, 2026, and they won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, while no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
